intent: Falsify C10 fastboot abstractions and compress them to the smallest causally separated bootstrap lattice before changing runtime acquisition semantics.

nodes.boundary: pure recognition must precede repository acquisition
repository bytes are not trusted without one immutable source root
runtime acquisition remains forbidden before exact human acceptance

owns: cache reuse only on exact root match
nodes.boundary: runtime transport shape and shard count are implementation parameters, not semantic authority
source integrity is not local-host capability evidence
capability observation is not state authority

folded_semantics.PREACCEPT_HANDOFF: fold into CONSENT_ROOT as validated authority-zero context rather than retain an independent lifecycle stage
folded_semantics.RESUME_PENDING_INTENT: fold into ACTIVE_COMMIT as an exactly-once terminal effect
folded_semantics.PLAN_OR_TIER_NAME: remove from bootstrap logic; feature/capability detection only
folded_semantics.FIXED_RUNTIME_SHARD_COUNT: remove from semantic topology; choose bounded content-addressed shards per host transport constraints
